meta.name: LEAD LAB
meta.author: MODDYS Foundry
meta.description: Sixty-four own-authored leads for Anvil's PolyBLEP VA engine: twelve unison stacks, twelve supersaw walls, ten glide-and-vibrato solo voices, ten punch stabs, ten expressive macro-laden leads and ten digital voices. The T8 'FM/PD leads' brief predates the shipped engine: its intent is realised with the available feature set - detuned/unison osc layers, WT osc2 timbres, fast-LFO growl and fold/crush drive in the DIGITAL section. SOLO/EXPRESSIVE presets carry mod.macroN expression defaults (vibrato depth / brightness / drive / delay). #lead #unison #supersaw #solo #expressive #digital #va
